description: PDDL+ plan validation checks a timed plan in a world that also changes by itself. A *process* runs while its precondition holds and changes fluents at a constant rate; an *event* fires at the first instant its precondition holds. Between two plan happenings, the validator splits time into segments with a fixed set of running processes, so every fluent changes linearly in each segment. It finds the exact time at which a process starts or stops or an event becomes enabled at the first root of a linear condition. Enabled events fire together and the check repeats, so one event can trigger the next (a *cascade*). Dynamics that are not linear are reported as unsupported, never as valid.

papers.title: Modelling Mixed Discrete-Continuous Domains for Planning

papers.authors: Richard Howey, Derek Long, Maria Fox
papers.title: VAL: automatic plan validation, continuous effects and mixed initiative planning using PDDL
papers.venue: 16th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI)
